correctness.rationale: The exact graph and four-cut/Alexander-dual definitions are fixed. The independently executable, all-subsets verifier checks 429 forbidden 4-sets and the full dual f-vector, then checks all 66 ordered elementary-collapse pairs for an actual unique coface at their removal step. The surviving 2-complex is simply connected and has reduced Euler characteristic 105. Hurewicz, Whitehead, integral combinatorial Alexander duality, and the full five-skeleton of the 7-dimensional cut complex give two integral sphere-wedge homotopy types. All 12 signed simplex traces are computed, the ambient automorphisms are even, and trace-averaging gives eight invariants. No extrapolation from finite samples is used.

value.rationale: The Dürer graph is the first triangle-bearing GP(n,2) member and lies beyond the girth-five four-cut theorem. This is a natural boundary case, not an arbitrary slice; the calculation supplies an integral homotopy type and complete twelve-element dihedral character, revealing an eight-dimensional invariant top-homology space unavailable from Euler counts or Betti numbers. A short verifiable collapse certificate makes the result reproducible and useful in subsequent symmetry comparisons.
